description: Known search sources, pure data. It never executes anything: only adapters registered in the provider registry can run; this file explains what is missing and how to set it up.

entries.label: DeepSeek native search (ctx.web)
entries.install: Provided by the DSH host web capability; configure a web provider in the host.
entries.cost: decided by the host provider behind ctx.web

verification.note: shipped built-in

recommendedFor: one general web query through whatever provider the host selected
notFor: evidence of independence: the upstream index is unknown

entries.label: Exa
entries.install: Set EXA_API_KEY (or exaApiKey). Without a key the mcporter MCP fallback works for plain queries only.

verification.note: shipped built-in

notFor: advanced filters through the mcporter fallback

entries.label: DuckDuckGo
entries.install: None (HTML endpoint, no key).

verification.note: shipped built-in

notFor: heavy or parallel use: rate limits and bot checks return empty pages

entries.label: Bing (RSS)
entries.install: None (RSS endpoint, no key).

verification.note: shipped built-in

notFor: native freshness or domain filters (only operators in the query)

entries.label: Jina AI search
entries.install: Set JINA_API_KEY (or jinaApiKey).

verification.note: shipped built-in

recommendedFor: general web search when a Jina key exists
notFor: keyless use: s.jina.ai answers 401 without a key

entries.label: Bocha (博查) web search
entries.install: Open a search balance or package at open.bochaai.com and set BOCHA_SEARCH_API_KEY (the Jev key of the same account is the fallback).
entries.cost: metered per request (Bocha balance or package)

verification.note: only an HTTP 403 (no balance) was recorded live on 2026-10-02; success mapping built from the reference provider

recommendedFor: Chinese web search with domain and date-range filters
notFor: accounts without a search package (403 no balance)

entries.label: GitHub search
entries.install: None; GITHUB_TOKEN (optional) raises the rate limit. Also search.run platform=github-code / github-issues.

verification.note: shipped built-in

notFor: natural-language questions (the query is reduced to keywords)

entries.label: GitHub code search

verification.note: REST search API; code search needs an authenticated request

entries.install: Set GITHUB_TOKEN (or settings githubToken): code search needs an authenticated request.
recommendedFor: finding real usages of an API or a config key in public code

entries.label: GitHub issues and pull requests

verification.note: REST search API; no live check recorded

entries.install: None; GITHUB_TOKEN (optional) raises the rate limit.
recommendedFor: known bugs, workarounds and maintainer answers for an error message

entries.label: Wikipedia (MediaWiki search)
entries.install: None. Language edition follows the task language.
entries.license: free API; article text CC BY-SA 4.0

verification.note: live 2026-10-02: en and zh editions answered; fixtures in test/fixtures

entries.label: Hacker News (Algolia)
entries.install: None.

verification.note: live 2026-10-02: plain query and created_at_i filter answered

recommendedFor: English developer opinions and launch discussions
what practitioners think of a tool

entries.label: Stack Exchange (Stack Overflow)
entries.install: None; anonymous requests share a small daily quota per IP.

verification.note: live 2026-10-02: plain query and fromdate answered; anonymous quota_max 300

recommendedFor: concrete programming errors and how-to questions

entries.label: OpenAlex works
entries.install: None. A free API key (OPENALEX_API_KEY) raises the daily budget tenfold.
entries.license: data CC0; API metered above the free budget
entries.cost: keyless budget is small (X-RateLimit-Limit 1000 observed; a free key gives ten times more; a search call costs $0.001)

verification.note: live 2026-10-02: plain query and from_publication_date answered

recommendedFor: finding papers across all fields with abstracts and citation counts
notFor: many queries per day without a key

entries.label: Semantic Scholar paper search
entries.install: None; unauthenticated requests share a pool and often get HTTP 429. A free key (x-api-key) is more reliable.

verification.note: live 2026-10-02: both anonymous requests got HTTP 429 (shared pool busy); success shape follows the API docs

recommendedFor: computer-science and related papers with abstracts and venues

entries.label: AnySearch
entries.install: None for the anonymous tier (limited per IP and per day). An invalid key never falls back to anonymous.
entries.cost: free daily anonymous quota, then paid

verification.note: live 2026-10-02: one anonymous request answered 200; the 402 quota path was not triggered live

recommendedFor: an extra keyless web source with zone cn / intl
notFor: quota-exhausted days: the 402 answer is reported as quota_exhausted and its generated credentials are discarded

entries.label: SearXNG (self-hosted)
entries.install: Run your own instance with `json` enabled under search.formats, then set searxngUrl in the settings. No public instance is built in.

verification.note: needs a user-run instance; never run live

recommendedFor: a private meta-search under your control
notFor: public instances: most disable the JSON format or rate-limit it

entries.label: Parallel Search MCP (anonymous tier)
entries.install: MCP endpoint https://search.parallel.ai/mcp (streamable HTTP, no key). Not an engine of this plugin: add it to the host as an MCP server.

verification.note: result text format of web_search is not documented; no adapter

recommendedFor: an MCP-native extra source for English web research
notFor: use as a search.run engine (no adapter)

verification.note: adapter built from the official API reference and the MIT dsh-web-search-tavily provider; never called live (no key)

notFor: Tavily generated answers: only ranked results are used
entries.label: Tavily
entries.install: Set TAVILY_API_KEY (or keyedSources.tavily.apiKey / a credentials ref); create a key at tavily.com. Inactive until a key is set.
entries.cost: metered in credits per request, free monthly allowance (check the plan)
recommendedFor: English research with an independent fallback index; native domain and date filters

verification.note: adapter built from the official documentation and API reference; error body shape undocumented; never called live (no key)

notFor: a 600-character query: it is cut to 400 characters and 50 words
entries.label: Brave Search API
entries.install: Set BRAVE_API_KEY (or keyedSources.brave.apiKey / a credentials ref); key from brave.com/search/api. Inactive until a key is set.
entries.cost: metered per successful request (per-second and monthly plan limits)
recommendedFor: source diversity: an independent index with site: / -site: operators and a date range

verification.note: adapter built from the official search reference and errors page; never called live (no key)

notFor: generated answers: only outputType searchResults is used
entries.label: Linkup
entries.install: Set LINKUP_API_KEY (or keyedSources.linkup.apiKey / a credentials ref); key from linkup.so (not linkupapi.com). Inactive until a key is set.
entries.cost: metered in credits per request (Linkup plan)
recommendedFor: overseas supplementary search with domain and date filters

verification.note: no public API reference: contract from MIT reference code (LangChain, searchsuite); never called live (no key)

notFor: independent corroboration of other Google-based sources (same family)
entries.label: Serper (Google SERP)
entries.install: Set SERPER_API_KEY (or keyedSources.serper.apiKey / a credentials ref); key from serper.dev. Inactive until a key is set.
entries.cost: metered in credits per request (Serper plan)

verification.note: official docs page not readable; contract from two MIT references (TZHR-invest dsh-web-search-metaso, HundunOnline mcp-metaso); never called live (no key)

notFor: generated answers and the reader endpoint: only raw webpage results are used
entries.label: Metaso (秘塔) search
entries.install: Set METASO_API_KEY (or keyedSources.metaso.apiKey / a credentials ref); key from metaso.cn/search-api. Webpage scope only; the reader is not implemented. Inactive until a key is set.
recommendedFor: Chinese web search (no documented site or date filter: constraints are checked locally)

verification.note: contract from the official guide, API reference and error-code page; never called live (no key)

notFor: GLM generated answers: only raw search_result is used; the query is cut to 70 characters
entries.label: Zhipu (智谱) web search
entries.install: Set ZHIPU_API_KEY (or keyedSources.zhipu.apiKey / a credentials ref); key from open.bigmodel.cn. Standalone web_search endpoint, search_std. Inactive until a key is set.
entries.cost: metered per request (about 0.01 CNY for search_std per the vendor page)
recommendedFor: second Chinese search source with one domain filter and a recency window

verification.note: official page contradicts itself on the auth header: both Authorization and X-Appbuilder-Authorization are sent; never called live (no key)

notFor: chat-completions generated answers: only web references are used; query cut to 72 units
entries.label: Baidu Qianfan (千帆) AI search
entries.install: Set QIANFAN_API_KEY (or BAIDU_API_KEY / keyedSources.baidu-qianfan.apiKey); AppBuilder key from the Baidu AI cloud console. Inactive until a key is set.
entries.cost: free daily quota of 100 calls, then paid post-payment
recommendedFor: Chinese general web search with site, exclude and date-range filters

verification.note: no adapter yet; facts from vendor documentation

notFor: use before an adapter exists in this plugin
entries.label: Parallel Search API / CLI
entries.install: Planned adapter for /v1/search; or parallel-cli (OAuth or key).
recommendedFor: higher limits than the anonymous MCP tier

entries.label: wx-search-cli (WeChat articles)
entries.install: npm i -g wx-search-cli (Node); no adapter in this plugin yet.

verification.note: not installed or run by this plugin

recommendedFor: WeChat official-account articles via Sogou search
notFor: stable unattended use: Sogou redirects and captchas change

entries.label: OmniReach CLI / MCP
entries.install: Python package from github.com/Daily-AC/omnireach; some platforms use its Chrome bridge or OpenCLI.

verification.note: not installed or run by this plugin

recommendedFor: WeChat discovery, author work lists and media text
